# Playwright spec files gated by the `e2e` check against the Vercel Preview.

# One repo-relative path per line. Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are
# ignored. Every listed file must exist, and none of its tests may be skipped.
# This file is protected, with one exception: a Pull Request that changes no
# other protected path may only add lines here, each blank, a `#` comment, or a
# new `e2e/<name>.spec.ts` that exists in the Pull Request head. Such a Pull
# Request passes `protected-paths`. Removing, reordering, or editing any line
# still needs the owner's bypass.
